reuse.why: Extends the existing shared applyWeekendRule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend and adds a shared isNonWorkingDay that every daily-skip check now calls, rather than adding holiday checks inline.

duplication.why: The day definition is shared, but the pre-existing per-site 'daily + skipWeekend -> skip' dispatch is edited in four places and the look-ahead window is widened by holidays.length with three different ad hoc formulas.

placement.why: Holiday/working-day logic lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend rule; server sites only pass config.holidays.

scope.why: All edits serve the holidays feature (type, parseRecurDate, rule, call sites, test).

maintainability.why: One working-day predicate and one shift loop are easy to own, but the skip-vs-move decision and the search-window sizing remain scattered across four sites with inconsistent margins.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All sites route through applyWeekendRule and the new isNonWorkingDay.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated window-widening (`14 + len`, `count*7+14+len`, `3+len`) is open, not disguised; the predicate itself is shared.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts isNonWorkingDay (used by getDateWithSkippedWeekend and all four daily-skip checks in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule-template), though the daily skip dispatch itself is still repeated per site.
